text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Manga.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With just a single book, a single page, a 
single panel... It completely captures 
your heart.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like a clash against a fated rival! Or a 
reunion between a parent and child torn 
apart by tragedy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Plus their chaotic comedy banter. 
Listening to stories about their daily 
life can bring a chuckle too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I love it all! Everything! Watching it, 
enjoying it—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And also creating things.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...Would you like to create it 
together?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In just one race, in just a hundred 
meters, in just one second—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A manga-like 'story' that'll make 
everyone's hearts race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day in April, Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the first leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown: the Satsuki Sho! Which 
Umamusume will seize her dream?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Satono family's very first 
GⅠ victory! The undefeated Satono Diamond 
surges forward!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... I will definitely...! Fulfill 
my clan's deepest wish—... Kuuh!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The others aren't giving an inch, either! 
Wait, look! Look! A terrifying burst of 
late speed is flying in from the far 
outside!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose...! I won't lose, I CAN'T 
lose! HAAAAAAAAAAH—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of this year's Satsuki Sho 
is—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An upset from the 8th favorite! The dark 
horse has defeated the undefeated 
Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...! A-Ahhh... what a 
comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm rooting for Dia! Next time too! 
Please... win the Satono family's first GⅠ 
title!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaa~~... It's so hot...! Everyone 
putting their feelings into the race—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Must be nice... .........—It really 
is!! All right, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Gooood morrrning! Trainer-saaann!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My trainee Kiseki came bounding into the 
Trainer's office full of energy. It seems 
something good must have happened.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, how was watching the 
Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, it was the absolute best! Every 
single spectator was completely glued to 
the race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The applause and cheers are super 
deafening! And everyone looking at the 
1st-place Umamusume has mega sparkly eyes!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Racing really is incredible! It draws 
people in, amazes them, and drives them 
wild with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to have a flashy, 
exciting race just like in a legendary 
manga too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And for that sake, too—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
First off, I've drawn a brand-new 40-page 
one-shot manga!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I finally finished it last night, so 
it's fresh out of the oven! Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the Umamusume I train, Kiseki, is... 
a 'creative-type Umamusume' who loves 
manga and loves drawing it just as much.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist of this new work— is the 
me from before I met you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"On that day, they were met with 
torrential rain so heavy that water pooled 
over the turf."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaaah! Mooooommy! I hate rain! I hate 
mud!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Eek... Wh-Why...? Why is that girl 
who's been taking 1st place non-stop in 
our group—"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: "—Honestly, what a waste."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"It's futile. Regardless of the weather, 
regardless of who stands in my way—the one 
who wins is me."

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"No way, there's no way we can win...! 
Hey, Kiseki-chan. Let's drop out 
together—"

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...It's just like a manga...!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Huh?" "What?"

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...This is definitely going to be 
interesting."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There were higher-ranked Umamusume in that 
rainy race. Still, with a track that 
atrocious, I felt like anything could 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"In such a picturesque downpour, hair and 
face soaking wet... going all out to 
defeat a strong opponent."

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "And we're gonna thrill everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "—Yaaaargh!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLASH-SPLASH-SPLOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Observer A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what!? First place went to 
Kiseki-chan!? She only just joined...!"

text_block_list.name: Observer B
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even the white bib is pitch black! I 
can't believe they ran through this heavy 
downpour! This is truly—’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It was fun."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It worked. I was doing cool stuff like in 
a manga! ...Just like a manga 
protagonist!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With my own two legs! I created a race 
where I'm the main character!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"And so I took the leap! Into the world of 
racing! To the place where I could become 
the protagonist!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm the main character, let's take 
the royal road first! Aim for the Classic 
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho... Aiming for the pinnacle that 
an Umamusume can only challenge once!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...How about this! Trainer, what do you 
think of my manga!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! There's so much to look 
forward to in the future, too, right?! And 
then—
choice_data_list:
Ah, you want to run the Triple Crown 
route!

Yeah, you want to run the Triple Crown 
route, right!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that one...! I bet that caught your 
eye too, didn't it, Trainer~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic Triple Crown Route" mentioned 
in the manga. It is the once-in-a-lifetime 
dream stage that every Umamusume yearns 
for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Nippon Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho— three races said to be won by 
'the fastest Umamusume,' 'the luckiest 
Umamusume,' and 'the strongest Umamusume,' 
respectively.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I really feel like the protagonist of 
this era will be born from this very 
route!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you have speed, luck, AND 
strength, then you're the "strongest and 
most popular protagonist" ever!!
choice_data_list:
True, that does sound like something a 
protagonist would do.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I want to see a race where you're 
the main star, too!

Yeah! I want to see a race where you're 
the star, too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me too! I fully intend to shine as the 
winner of the artwork made by these legs!"
choice_data_list:
I'm really looking forward to the story 
you create!

I'm looking forward to the story you'll 
create!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And our story going forward is no longer a 
one-shot. It's an ongoing serialized manga 
where the ending is still unknown!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What begins here is the most thrilling 
'story' of ours ever!
